Gardener Doncaster

A full garden tidy-up, done properly

Sometimes the garden just needs a proper reset. Our gardeners in Doncaster handle the whole job in one go: weeding the beds, pruning shrubs, trimming hedges back into shape and cleaning everything up so you can see the garden again.

Because we're horticulturalists, we prune with the plant in mind: the right cut, at the right time of year, so it grows back healthier and flowers where it should. Hedges are cut straight and even, and kept off fences, paths and footpaths.

A one-off tidy-up is also a great way to start. Once the garden is back on track, a garden maintenance program keeps it there without you having to book each visit.

What's included

  • Weeding garden beds, paths and paving
  • Pruning shrubs, roses and small trees
  • Hedge trimming and shaping
  • Cutting back overgrowth from paths and fences
  • Green waste cleaned up
  • Advice on what your garden needs next

How it works

How a garden tidy-up works

  1. Quote

    Send through some details or photos of the garden and what you'd like done.

  2. Plan the job

    We agree on priorities: weeds, hedges, pruning, clean-up.

  3. Tidy-up day

    Our team works through the garden and leaves it clean.

  4. Keep it that way

    Optional ongoing care with a garden program.

FAQ

Garden Tidy-Ups FAQs

Do you take the green waste away?

We clean up after every job. Let us know in your quote request if there's a large amount of green waste, so we can plan for it.

Can you trim tall hedges?

Yes, we trim and shape hedges of most sizes. Tell us roughly how tall and long the hedge is when you request a quote.

Do you do regular gardening as well as one-offs?

Yes. Many clients start with a tidy-up and move onto a scheduled garden maintenance program.

Are you insured?

Yes, we're fully insured for residential and commercial work.
